title: MACGPi configuration schema
description: Schema for the configuration file of the MACGPi framework

entry.description: The entry point phase for the MACGPi execution

phases.description: Configuration for each phase in the MACGPi pipeline

inputs.description: The input files for this phase, specified as key-value pairs where the key is the input name and the value is the file path relative to the output directory

schema.description: Whether an output schema is present.

path.description: The directory path where the phase's prompts and output schema are located

next.description: The next phase to execute after the current ends. Use 'dynamic' for dynamic phase transitions based on the LLMs decision.

output_file.description: The file path for the phase's output, relative to the phase's path. Required if 'schema' is true.

max_visits.description: The maximum amount of times this phase is allowed to be visited. If this limit is exceeded, the pipeline continues to 'max_visits_exceeded_next'. If not specified, a maximum of 1 is enforced.

max_visits_exceeded_next.description: The next phase to execute if the 'max_visits' limit is exceeded. If not present the pipeline will finish. Cannot be dynamic.
